subject.title: [Feature]: Remove the Context Profile presets card from Quick Settings

question: Should Quick Settings remove the Context Profile presets entirely and replace the card footer with a slim pending-draft action bar while leaving the three context tuning keys only in Advanced settings?
rationale: This removes an existing visible settings workflow and the issue carries the protected `maintainer` label, so automation should not choose the product direction on its own.

options.title: Approve the removal path
options.body: Remove the preset surface and keep only a generic unsaved-changes action bar in Quick Settings, with the context keys still editable in Advanced settings.

options.title: Keep a reduced preset surface
options.body: Retain a collapsed or renamed Context Profile entry if maintainers still want presets visible in Simple settings despite the duplicate edit path.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave the current card in place and treat the prominence/disclaimer concern as acceptable product tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Approve the removal path
recommendation.body: Remove the preset surface and keep only a generic unsaved-changes action bar in Quick Settings, with the context keys still editable in Advanced settings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened this issue, is listed as a project maintainer, and recently authored the current Settings declutter code path.
